root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; t="$root/node_modules/.bin/tsx"; [ -x "$t" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$root" NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=@steamfield/decks/source "$t" packages/node/src/cli.ts hook prompt
